# Thailand Island Hopping with Kids - Family Guide (2026)

Thailand's islands are a family paradise, but island hopping with kids requires more planning than a solo backpacking trip. Shorter ferry rides, family-friendly resorts, and calm beaches make all the difference.

## Best Family Islands at a Glance

| Island | Vibe | Best For | Travel Time from Phuket |
|--------|------|---------|------------------------|
| Koh Lanta | Relaxed, uncrowded | Toddlers & young kids | 2 hours by road + ferry |
| Koh Yao Noi | Secluded, quiet | Families wanting peace | 30 min speedboat |
| Railay | Adventure, cliffs | Active families | 2 hours by car + longtail |
| Koh Phi Phi | Busy, lively | Older kids (8+) | 2 hours by ferry |
| Koh Samui | Resort-filled | All ages | Fly direct (1 hr) |

## Getting Between Islands

### Ferry Tips with Kids
- Book ferries with indoor seating with AC
- Bring seasickness meds for yourself (kids rarely get seasick)
- Choose speedboats only for trips under 1 hour
- The "Seatran Ferry" and "Tigerline" have the most comfortable family seating
- Book via [12Go Asia](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/32434-thailand-ferry-tickets/)

### Recommended Routes

**Option A: Phuket-based (5-7 days)**
Phuket -> Koh Yao Noi (30 min) -> Railay (1 hr) -> Back to Phuket

**Option B: Krabi-based (5-7 days)**
Krabi -> Railay (20 min longtail) -> Koh Lanta (1 hr) -> Return

**Option C: Samui-based (7 days)**
Koh Samui -> Koh Phangan -> Koh Tao (each 30-60 min apart)

## Koh Lanta - Best for Toddlers and Young Kids

Koh Lanta is our top pick for families with young children. Long, flat beaches with gentle waves, virtually no party scene, and excellent family resorts.

### Best Beaches for Kids
- **Long Beach** - 5 km of flat sand, shallow water, gentle waves. Most family resorts here.
- **Klong Dao** - Closest to the pier, good restaurants, very calm water.
- **Kantiang Bay** - More secluded, excellent snorkeling at the rocks.

### Where to Stay
- [Pimalai Resort](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Lanta&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Top tier, private pool villas, excellent kids' club
- [Lanta Sand Resort](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Lanta&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Good mid-range, right on Long Beach
- [Lanta Palace](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Lanta&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Budget option, basic but clean

### Family Activities
- Snorkeling trip to Koh Ngai and Koh Muk (emerald cave) - half day, calm waters
- Lanta Animal Welfare - volunteer or visit rescued dogs and cats
- Thai cooking class for families
- Visit the Old Town on weekend evenings

## Koh Yao Noi - The Hidden Gem

A 30-minute speedboat from Phuket, this island feels like stepping back in time. No party scene, very few cars (mostly scooters), and stunning natural beauty.

### Best for: Families who want quiet, quality time

### Where to Stay
- [Six Senses Yao Noi](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Yao+Noi&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Ultra-luxury, private pool villas, incredible kids' club
- [Sabeinglae Resort](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Yao+Noi&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Mid-range, beautiful beachfront bungalows
- [Yao Noi Island Resort](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Koh+Yao+Noi&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Budget-friendly options

### Family Activities
- Bike around the island (flat, quiet roads)
- Kayak through the mangroves
- Visit Pasai Beach for the best sunset
- Private longtail boat tour to nearby islands

## Railay - Adventure Island

Accessible only by longtail boat, Railay is a stunning peninsula with limestone cliffs, turquoise water, and excellent beaches. More active than relaxing.

### Best for: Families with older kids who want adventure

### Where to Stay
- [Rayavadee](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Railay&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Exclusive resort in jungle setting (luxury)
- [Railay Bay Resort](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Railay&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Good mid-range on East Railay
- [Any budget bungalow](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Railay&checkin=2026-06-01&checkout=2026-06-05&group_adults=2&group_children=2) - Simple but clean options

### Family Activities
- Rock climbing (real but beginner-friendly routes, kids as young as 5 can try)
- Kayak through the mangroves
- Walk to Phra Nang Cave Beach (stunning)
- Railay Viewpoint hike (steep but short - ages 8+)
- Snorkeling at the rocks

## Sample 7-Day Itinerary: Phuket + Koh Yao Noi + Railay

### Day 1: Arrive Phuket
Check into Phuket hotel (Patong or Kata). Pool time. Dinner at a family-friendly restaurant.

### Day 2: Phuket
[Book Phuket activities on Klook](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/30999-phuket-gibbon-rehabilitation/)
Morning: Gibbon Rehabilitation Centre. Afternoon: Pool and beach. Evening: Phuket Weekend Market (if it's the weekend).

### Day 3: Koh Yao Noi
30-minute speedboat from Phuket to Koh Yao Noi. Check in, rent bikes, explore the island. Dinner at Sabai Corner (beachfront, great Thai food).

### Day 4: Koh Yao Noi
Boat trip to Koh Hong (emerald lagoon, stunning snorkeling). Half day only. Afternoon: relax at Pasai Beach.

### Day 5: Railay
Morning speedboat to Railay (via Krabi). Check in. Afternoon: Phra Nang Cave Beach - one of the world's most beautiful beaches. Kayak at sunset.

### Day 6: Railay
Rock climbing lesson for the family (half day). Kayak through the mangroves. Visit Railay Viewpoint (early morning before heat).

### Day 7: Depart
Longtail to Ao Nang, taxi to Krabi airport. Or return to Phuket for your flight.

## What to Pack for Island Hopping

- Lightweight stroller (umbrella-style - fits on boats)
- Life jackets for kids (some boats don't have small sizes)
- Snorkel masks (bring your own for proper fit)
- Rash guards and SPF 50+ sunscreen
- Seasickness bands or medication
- Dry bags (for phones, wallets, tablets)
- Quick-dry towels
- Water shoes (rocky beaches, boat transfers)

## Safety Tips

- Always check weather before booking any boat trip (June-October has rougher seas)
- Kids must wear life jackets on all speedboats (insist on it)
- Watch for sea urchins in rocky areas (water shoes are essential)
- Never leave kids unattended near the water - even on "calm" beaches
- 7-Eleven is everywhere and has decent first-aid supplies

## The Verdict

Koh Lanta is the best island for families with young children. Koh Yao Noi is perfect for peace and quiet. Railay is ideal for active families with older kids. Avoid Koh Phi Phi and Koh Phangan with young children - too crowded and party-focused.
